title: a webhook trigger reaches the watch list
asserts: a prWebhook frame is accepted without an error frame, for a PR under watch and for one nobody tracks, and neither one re-announces the list — the refresh it schedules is answered by a trackedPrs frame only if it actually moved the list, which a run whose gh cannot reach GitHub never does.

steps.note: the repo is not stored on the watch until a gh round trip resolves it, and this run's gh cannot reach GitHub, so what has to match here is the owner/name in the PR url the watch was tracked with
a PR nobody watches: a webhook fires for every PR in a repo, so this is an ordinary no-op and must not be an error

past the debounce and the refresh behind it: gh fails, so the refresh learns nothing, and a list that did not change is not re-announced. This is what an accepted trigger looks like from the wire when GitHub is unreachable — the frame is taken, the fetch happens, and nothing is claimed.
